name: a2 Milk Full Cream 2L

visual_identity.silhouette: tall flat-front bottle with rounded shoulders, a short wide neck, gently tapered sidewalls, and a flat base
visual_identity.grip_geometry: shallow curved side indentations only; the plastic body remains solid
visual_identity.front_label: green rectangular label with a large purple a2 roundel, a blue Full cream band, and a visible 2L mark
visual_identity.back_label: large white rectangular label with purple heading, cow comparison, nutrition panel, barcode, ingredient line, and 2L FULL CREAM footer
visual_identity.geometry_evidence: Read from the front and back packshots target_A2_1.png and target_A2_2.png: the shoulder shows two recessed grip panels with no see-through opening. No side view was supplied; confirm with the physical bottle before relying on side angles.

storage: Keep refrigerated below 4°C and consume within five days of opening.

facts.text: The only ingredient is milk; the product is homogenised and pasteurised.
Contains 3.3 grams of protein per 100 millilitres.
Contains 109 milligrams of calcium per 100 millilitres.
Each bottle contains 2 litres, or approximately eight 250 millilitre servings.
facts.evidence: Front and back labels in target_A2_1.png and target_A2_2.png.

facts.text: The operator-provided price is AUD 6.79 per bottle.

forbidden_claims: four grams of protein per hundred millilitres
